summary: Scoped marketing research for FellowScript, a faith-based Bible study platform (web React + iOS Swift, free/paid subscription model via Stripe/Apple IAP) with group/social, note-taking, highlighting, and AI devotional check-in features. Plan mandates reading the app's own README and docs/ (design, architecture, index) first to ground recommendations, then researching faith-app-specific ASO, community/partnership, content, and referral-growth channels tied to those concrete features and its parchment-and-gold reverent-editorial brand identity. Credential/secret files in the repo are explicitly excluded.
